description: Building blocks for form fields that pair controls with labels, descriptions and error messages.
overview:
A `Field` wraps one control together with its `FieldLabel`, an optional `FieldDescription` and an optional `FieldError`. It automatically adds the ids of its descriptions and errors to the control's `aria-describedby`, so supporting text is announced with the control. Use `FieldContent` to stack a label and description beside a control in a horizontal field, and `FieldTitle` for a non-label heading inside a field.

`FieldGroup` stacks fields with consistent spacing, and its `inset` variant groups them into a rounded list, like iOS Settings. `FieldSet` and `FieldLegend` group related fields under a caption, and `FieldSeparator` divides sections, optionally with text. Use these parts with any control in the library, such as `Input`, `Textarea`, `Checkbox`, `Switch` or `RadioGroup`.
usage:
Connect each `FieldLabel` to its control with `htmlFor` and `id`. Set `orientation="horizontal"` to place the label beside the control, for example for a checkbox or switch, or `responsive` to switch from vertical to horizontal when the surrounding `FieldGroup` is wide enough.

To show an error, set `aria-invalid` on the control and render a `FieldError` with children or an `errors` array. Pass `data-disabled` on a `Field` to dim its label when the control is disabled.

To build selectable cards, place a horizontal `Field` inside a `FieldLabel`; the label gets a border, and a highlighted ring when the control inside it is checked.

examples.WithHelpLink: A description that contains a link, styled with the link color and an underline.
examples.Inset: Horizontal fields in an `inset` field group, forming a rounded settings list with separators.
examples.WithTextarea: A field that labels and describes a `Textarea`.
examples.Invalid: An invalid field with an error message announced as an alert.
examples.MultipleErrors: A `FieldError` that renders an `errors` array as a bulleted list.
examples.Disabled: A disabled field with a dimmed label and a disabled input.
examples.Horizontal: Horizontal fields with a checkbox and a switch, one with a description in `FieldContent`.
examples.ChoiceCards: Radio options presented as selectable cards by nesting a `Field` inside a `FieldLabel`.
examples.Form: A complete payment form built from field sets, groups, a separator and actions.
examples.SeparatorWithText: A `FieldSeparator` with text between a sign-in button and an email field.

parts.FieldSet: Groups related fields in a native `fieldset`.
parts.FieldLegend: The caption of a field set.
parts.FieldGroup: Stacks fields with consistent spacing, or groups them into an inset list.
parts.Field: Wraps a single control with its label, description and error.
parts.FieldContent: Stacks a label and description next to a control in a horizontal field.
parts.FieldLabel: The label of a field's control.
parts.FieldTitle: A heading inside a field that is not a label, such as the title of a choice card.
parts.FieldDescription: Supporting text that describes the control.
parts.FieldSeparator: A divider between sections, with optional centered text.
parts.FieldError: An error message for the field.

FieldLegend.variant: Sets `data-variant` to `legend` or `label` so the legend can be styled as a section caption or as a field label.

FieldGroup.variant: `inset` groups the fields into a rounded list on a secondary surface, with separators between rows and inputs aligned to the end.

Field.orientation: `vertical` stacks the label above the control, `horizontal` places them side by side, and `responsive` switches to horizontal when the field group is wide enough.

FieldSeparator.children: Optional text centered on the separator line.

FieldError.errors: A list of error objects to display. Duplicate messages are removed; one message renders as text and several render as a list. Ignored when children are provided.

accessibility:
- `Field` has the `group` role and links its descriptions and errors to its first control through `aria-describedby`, updating the link when they change.
- `FieldSet` renders a native `fieldset`, which takes its accessible name from `FieldLegend`.
- `FieldError` has the `alert` role, so assistive technology announces it when it appears. It renders nothing when it has no children and no errors.
- Set `aria-invalid` on the control to mark it invalid; `FieldError` does not set it for you.
- Clicking a `FieldLabel` focuses or toggles its associated control.
notes:
- Styling hooks: `data-slot` values `field-set`, `field-legend`, `field-group`, `field`, `field-content`, `field-label` (used by both `FieldLabel` and `FieldTitle`), `field-description`, `field-separator` and `field-error`.
- `Field` sets `data-orientation`, and `FieldGroup` and `FieldLegend` set `data-variant`.
- `FieldGroup` is a container query context named `field-group`, which drives the `responsive` orientation.
- Uses the `surface-secondary`, `separator`, `label-secondary`, `link`, `danger`, `accent` and `item-hover` tokens.
